Download the country mask from the Copernicus CDS

Source: R/download.R
download_mask.Rd

Downloads the ERA5 land-sea mask for the given bounding box, then rescales it to [0, 1] and saves it as mask_<country_abbrev>.nc in dest_dir. The mask variable is renamed to country so it is directly compatible with apply_mask.

Usage

download_mask(
  country_abbrev = "FRA",
  area = c(51.5, -5.5, 41, 10),
  dest_dir = NULL,
  overwrite = FALSE
)

Arguments

country_abbrev

Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code (e.g. "FRA").

area

Numeric vector c(north, west, south, east). Default: metropolitan France.

dest_dir

Character. Directory for the output file. Default: "data/era5/<country_abbrev>/".

overwrite

Logical. Overwrite if the file already exists. Default FALSE.

Value

Invisibly, the path to the mask NetCDF file.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
cds_set_key("xxxxxxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx")

# Produces: data/era5/FRA/mask_FRA.nc
download_mask(
  country_abbrev = "FRA",
  area      = c(51.5, -5.5, 41.0, 10.0)
)
} # }
